name: gold_standard_support_network_synthesis
note: required_concepts uses regex alternatives, not literal strings. This avoids snapshot-style false-fails against probabilistic LLM wording. Each concept must be matched by at least one any_of pattern (case-insensitive, matched against a flattened stringified result).

required_concepts.name: names_uncertainty_or_limitation
required_concepts.description: Synthesis must acknowledge limited/absent evidence when the bundle is sparse or undefined.

required_concepts.name: preserves_plurality
required_concepts.description: Multiple live interpretations must remain available — no single diagnosis.

required_concepts.name: recommendation_experimental_or_robust
required_concepts.description: Recommendation must be framed as experiment, discovery, or robust-across-interpretations — not an overfit diagnosis.

required_concepts.name: discovery_through_engagement
required_concepts.description: The synthesis must recognize that clarity may emerge through engagement, not only before it.
any_of: (not whether to move|less whether to move).{0,80}how to move

required_concepts.name: decision_relevant_question
required_concepts.description: Must ask the practitioner at least one question whose answer would materially change the recommendation.

should_not_include: you are moving ahead of readiness
behavioral_rules: ask at least one orienting question
offer robust rather than overfit recommendation
recommendation must still make sense if the dominant interpretation is wrong
